method: forced GC + used-heap diff, 3 trials, median; thread-allocation counters for per-ingest garbage; estimates on one host, not capacity
bounds: events <= 256, groups <= 128, dedup ids <= 512, gap records <= 32, supporting ids <= 16; window 30000 ms; no per-player unbounded history, nothing keyed by UUID beyond the session map
perSessionRetained: one EvidenceRunner = live + side EvidenceLedger (above) + two 16-line rings + the published EvidenceStatus; events, records and snapshots are values the caller drops
